prompt: Build a 5-qubit circuit implementing, as a general-purpose circuit block: Hadamard on all 5 qubits, then the phase exp(-i*gamma*H) where H = 0.5*Z0*Z2 - 0.4*Z1*Z3 + 0.3*Z2*Z4. gamma = 0.45. This circuit will be transpiled for a 5-qubit LINEAR coupling map (qubit i only physically adjacent to qubit i-1 and i+1) — every pair here is two apart on that line (not directly adjacent), so some routing overhead is expected. Any correct implementation of the phase terms is accepted. No measurement.
